01 · Business automation

Automation is about giving time back.

Business automation means systems carry out recurring tasks for you: moving data between programs, sending confirmations, preparing documents and sending reminders. It frees up time, reduces manual errors and stops things falling through the cracks.

n8n is a workflow tool where an event – a new email, a booking, a payment – triggers a chain of steps across your systems. It can be self-hosted in your own environment or used as a cloud service, and works well when ready-made integrations are not enough.

Signs it is time to automate

  • You copy the same information between systems by hand.
  • Enquiries and emails sit unanswered because nobody has time.
  • Reports and invoice data take hours to compile each month.
  • Customer data lives in several places and does not match.

What we can automate

  • n8n workflows
  • Incoming email handling
  • Lead capture and qualification
  • CRM automation
  • Customer onboarding
  • Bookings and reminders
  • Data synchronisation between platforms
  • Automated reporting
  • Invoice and document processing
  • API integrations
  • Internal business workflows

Example: from enquiry to booked meeting

  1. IN
    Enquiry arrivesVia form, email or booking system
  2. n8n
    Workflow startsDetails are checked and structured
  3. CRM
    Customer is registeredNo manual data entry
  4. CAL
    Meeting is bookedThe calendar updates automatically
  5. OUT
    Confirmation is sentThe customer gets a reply, you get a notification

The result: less manual work, fewer mistakes and faster replies to your customers.

02 · AI automation & AI agents

AI that is useful day to day, not just in demos.

An AI agent is software that can read information, make simple decisions and carry out steps in your systems to reach a goal. We build agents for well-defined tasks where the benefit is clear and a person still has the final say.

  • AI customer support assistant

    Answers common questions from your own information and hands over to a person when needed.

  • Email and message handling

    Sorts, summarises and prepares draft replies that you review before they are sent.

  • Document processing

    Reads invoices, contracts and forms and passes the data to the right system.

  • Knowledge assistant

    Makes your manuals, procedures and policies searchable through plain questions and answers.

  • Lead qualification

    Assesses incoming enquiries so you contact the right people first.

  • Administrative support

    Compiles documents, meeting notes and reports.

  • Custom AI agents

    Tailored to one specific task in your business.

  • Connected to existing systems

    AI that works inside the tools you already use, without switching.

AI sometimes gets things wrong. That is why we build in review, logging and clear limits on what an agent may do, and we start small where the risk is low.

03 · Local & private AI

AI that runs in your own environment.

Many AI services send your data to an external provider. With local or private AI, the model runs on your own server, in a controlled environment or on hardware you own, so you decide where the information goes.

FAQ

Answers to what most people ask.

What is business automation?

Business automation means recurring tasks are carried out by systems instead of by hand, for example moving data between programs, sending confirmations, producing reports or sorting incoming email. The aim is to save time, reduce errors and let staff focus on work that needs people.

When should a company automate?

When the same task is done often, follows the same rules and takes noticeable time, or when information has to be entered in several places. Tasks that are rare or need a lot of judgement are usually not worth automating first.

What is an AI agent and what can it do?

An AI agent is software that can read information, make simple decisions and carry out steps in your systems to reach a goal, for example sorting incoming email, summarising documents or answering common customer questions. We build in review and limits so a person has the final say where it matters.

What is local AI and how does it differ from cloud AI?

Local AI means the AI model runs on a server you control instead of with an external provider. That gives you more control over where data is processed. The trade-off is that local models can be less capable than the largest cloud models, and hardware and operations need to be factored in.

Is local AI secure and GDPR-compliant?

Local AI can give you better control over data, but it is not automatically secure or GDPR-compliant. That depends on how the solution is set up, what data is handled and how it is operated. We therefore make no absolute guarantees. It needs a technical and legal assessment for your situation.

How does n8n work?

n8n is a workflow tool. An event, such as a new email or booking, starts a chain of steps that connect your systems. n8n has many ready-made integrations and can also connect to custom APIs. It can run in your own environment or as a cloud service.

Do we need to replace our systems to automate?

Usually not. We connect the tools you already use through their integrations or APIs. If a system cannot be connected, we will tell you and suggest alternatives.

What does it cost?

It depends on the scope. We work with a fixed scope and give you a clear proposal with a price after a first conversation, so you know what is included before we start. The first conversation is free.

How long does a project take?

It depends on how many systems and steps are involved. A well-defined workflow is quicker than a larger integration or a custom application. We provide a timeline after the initial analysis.

Can you build and maintain our website?

Yes. We design and develop websites from scratch and offer ongoing support and maintenance so the site stays working, secure and up to date.
